name: field-kit
description: Event-led pipeline for B2B teams: a 90-day field plan, target account mirrors, competitor events, co-hosts, an event ledger and a weekly accounts-in-motion report.

interface.longDescription: Plan 90 days of field marketing from your target accounts. Find lookalike accounts in a region, map competitor events and gaps, find co-hosts, log every event against the target list, and see which accounts to work this week. Works best with an Exa API key.
